design: Large-scale randomized controlled trial of Check & Connect

correct_citation: Davis, C. L., Tomporowski, P. D., McDowell, J. E., Austin, B. P., Miller, P. H., Yanasak, N. E., Allison, J. D., & Naglieri, J. A. (2011). Health Psychology, 30(1), 91-98. doi:10.1037/a0021766
